maxCompanies.title: Maximum Companies
maxCompanies.description: Maximum number of companies to scrape (leave empty for all)

includeFounderDescriptions.title: Include Founder Descriptions
includeFounderDescriptions.description: Include founder bio descriptions (requires company page scrape)

includeJobDetails.title: Include Job Details
includeJobDetails.description: Scrape individual job pages for full details (job type, role category, visa, description, apply URL). Set to false for faster scraping with basic job info only.

notionConnector.title: Notion connector
notionConnector.description: Optional. Write every scraped job straight into a Notion database as a new page. Your Notion credentials stay on Apify and never reach this Actor.
notionConnector.sectionDescription: Send results to a Notion database instead of exporting the dataset by hand. Authorize a Notion connector once under Settings > API & Integrations, then pick it here.

notionDataSourceId.title: Notion data source ID
notionDataSourceId.description: Data source to write jobs into, e.g. collection://3b9c6736-e91f-8087-808a-000ba66b1ae4. This is NOT the database ID - a Notion database can contain several data sources, and pages are parented on a data source. Required when a Notion connector is selected.

notionMaxRows.title: Max jobs to write to Notion
notionMaxRows.description: Safety cap on how many job pages get created in one run. Leave empty to write every scraped job.

notionDebugSchema.title: Dump Notion tool schemas
notionDebugSchema.description: Diagnostic: write the connector's tool schemas to the NOTION_TOOL_SCHEMA key-value record and skip writing pages.
